title: Mini-guide helpbar & context cards for quickstart flows
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design and ship a compact, skippable ‘helpbar’ and set of context-aware doc-link cards that surface within quickstart flows and feature routes. The goal is to reduce time-to-value for new users (first 3 sessions) by providing targeted micro-guides, one-tap links to relevant docs, and contextual screenshots without interrupting task flow. This ticket covers UX patterns, copy variants, accessibility requirements, annotated screenshots, and a screenshot capture run for release collateral.
acceptance_criteria: Helpbar appears on first visit to Quickstart and Task routes and can be dismissed; dismissal persists per-org for 30 days
Each helpbar variant includes a primary CTA (Try sample prompt / Open tutorial) and a secondary doc-link menu with 2–3 topic cards
Context cards show an inline screenshot thumbnail, 1-line summary, and an external doc link; clicking opens doc in new tab and records analytics
UX reviewed and approved by PM and Accessibility lead; WCAG AA contrast and keyboard focus verified
Design handoff includes annotated Figma frames, copy table, PNG export at 2x and 3x for marketing, and two example screenshots for release notes
design_notes: Layout: bottom-left anchored helpbar (320px wide) with optional expanded side-panel (480px) for walkthroughs
Variants: compact (single-line pill with icon), expanded (three doc-link cards), and walkthrough (multi-step overlay)
Microcopy tone: concise, action-oriented; avoid platform jargon for first-run users
Animations: subtle slide-up and fade; motion duration 180ms to stay under perceived latency SLOs
Accessibilty: all interactive elements keyboard-focusable, aria-live region for ephemeral tips, and 4.5:1 contrast for primary CTA
Responsive: on widths <600px collapse helpbar into a tappable header chip that expands full-width into a modal
decisions: Use bottom-left helpbar instead of top-right tooltip to avoid covering common console controls
Limit doc-link cards to 3 per route to reduce cognitive load and fit 480px wide side-panel
Persist user dismissal at org-level to avoid repeated interruptions for teams on trial accounts
Prefer opening docs in new tab to keep users in the console and enable easy return to flow
tradeoffs: Keeping dismissal at org-level may hide help from new teammates; mitigated by adding a ‘Show tips’ command in the Help menu
Thumbnail screenshots increase bundle size; mitigated by lazy-loading images and serving WebP at 2x for retina
Choosing side-panel walkthrough over full modal keeps context but limits available surface for longer tutorials
feedback: PM (Riley Chen): prefer primary CTA to open an interactive sample rather than an external doc — added as variant
Eng (Priya Nair): requested analytics hooks (helpbar_shown, helpbar_dismissed, doc_click) to be in telemetry plan
Accessibility (Jon Mercado): requested explicit focus trap for expanded walkthrough and aria-describedby for screenshots
